context_for_next_testing_agent: Análisis de Compras module is functional. Key findings: 1) POST /api/compras/analisis works for both MPRO and SoftRestaurant servers. 2) GET /api/compras/facturas-proveedor only works for MPRO (SoftRestaurant returns []). 3) GET /api/compras/detalle-factura only works for MPRO (SoftRestaurant returns []). 4) Frontend correctly displays KPIs (Total Compras, Proveedores, Promedio, Meses). 5) Table shows proveedores with monthly breakdown. 6) Drill-down UI works but shows 'No facturas' for SoftRestaurant due to missing backend implementation. 7) MPRO server may be in cooldown mode (backoff exponential) if connection fails.

facturas_proveedor_softrestaurant.current_behavior: Returns empty array for SoftRestaurant servers
facturas_proveedor_softrestaurant.suggested_query: SELECT idcompra as folio, fechaaplicacion as fecha, COUNT(*) as productos, SUM(total) as importe FROM compras WHERE idproveedor = ? AND YEAR(fechaaplicacion) = ? GROUP BY idcompra, fechaaplicacion

detalle_factura_softrestaurant.current_behavior: Returns empty array for SoftRestaurant servers
detalle_factura_softrestaurant.suggested_query: SELECT cd.idinsumo as codigo, i.descripcion as producto, cd.cantidad, cd.costo, cd.importe FROM comprasdetalle cd JOIN insumos i ON cd.idinsumo = i.idinsumo WHERE cd.idcompra = ?
